messages:
alex: Hi team — flight's delayed, I'm stuck at the airport. Also just got a page for degraded embeddings in eu-west. I need someone to take primary immediately. I can still do shadow for ~1h but can't be primary. Paging details below.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 2:04 PM UTC — embeddings-service (eu-west) high error rate > 8% (85% requests failing for short window). PagerDuty: PD#INC-2319. Incident runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/sys/embeds-eu-west

maria-g: I can jump primary for the next 4 hours. Taking over now. @alex, want me to run the rollback to v1.3.1 or try the scaling step first? :thumbsup:

alex: @maria-g please try scaling first — last successful mitigation in prod was scale + cache flush. If scaling doesn't drop errors in 5m, rollback. Leaving notes in pager. Thanks so much.

sam: I can shadow for the first 45m, check logs and metrics. Also happy to run the rollback if needed.

jordan: I'll be secondary; I'll keep an eye on customer-facing latency charts and update the status page. Link: https://status.redwood.company/incidents/INC-2319.

ops-lead: Pointers — follow the embed failure runbook section "transient overload". Key commands:
```bash
# increase replicas for eu-west embeddings pool
redctl scale --region eu-west --service embeddings --replicas 6
# flush prefix cache (non-blocking)
redctl cache flush --region eu-west --prefix embeddings/prefix-1
```
If errors persist after 5m, escalate to rollback: `deploy rollback embeddings v1.3.1 --region eu-west`.

maria-g: Scaling now. Running `redctl scale --region eu-west --service embeddings --replicas 6` — got ack from infra: scaling started.

sam: Watching logs, errors still spiking but the tail shows a surge of 503s from the shard host pool-12. Raising a quick infra ticket to check backend connectivity.

incident-bot: Update: Scaling completed (6 replicas). Error rate dropping from 85% -> 28% in 90s. Telemetry: tail-latency back to normal-ish, but error rate still above SLO.

maria-g: Cache flush complete. Error rate now 6% and falling. I'm keeping primary and will monitor for next 30m. @jordan please confirm status page update.

jordan: Status updated — labeled: "Degraded (partial) — mitigations in progress". Sent customer-facing note to impacted tenancy list.

alex: Amazing. I'm still en route but will do final handoff notes in runbook when I land. Thanks @maria-g @sam @jordan. If anything spikes, @ops-lead can escalate.

ops-lead: Good handling. Couple of postmortem asks: capture request-id samples from 14:02–14:08 UTC, and include the shard host IDs (pool-12). Add them to the incident thread in PD. Also add suggested follow-up: look at kernel version on pool-12 hosts, and check network flapping logs.

maria-g: Will do. Adding attachments and logs to PD#INC-2319. I'll hold primary until 17:20 UTC then hand back to alex or whoever is available.

sam: I'll stay shadow for the buffer period and run the rollback if needed.

alex: Thanks all. I'll post a short post-incident note once I'm at a stable connection. :raised_hands:
